default.notes: A visitor's visa must be obtained from a Jamaican mission or honorary consulate before travelling — there is no visa on arrival and no eVisa.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals enter under Caribbean Community free-movement arrangements — a definite entry of up to six months is granted on arrival.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days; the free online Immigration/Customs C5 form must still be completed before travelling.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days under Jamaica's waiver for Latin American passports; complete the online C5 form before departure.
Commonwealth citizens are admitted visa-free for up to 90 days; the online C5 immigration and customs form is still mandatory.
Visa-free for up to 90 days under a bilateral waiver — confirm the current allowance with a Jamaican mission before a long stay.
Visa-free for up to 30 days under the mutual visa-exemption agreement signed with China — confirm the current terms with a Jamaican mission before booking.
Commonwealth membership does not carry a visa waiver for this nationality — apply for a Jamaican visitor's visa before travelling.

JM.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Jamaican citizens.

TW.notes: Jamaica recognises Beijing rather than Taipei — ROC (Taiwan) passport holders should arrange a visa in advance and confirm with a Jamaican mission before booking.
